- File: scripts/review_run_reviewers.sh
  Line: reviewer_log_advance_action (new helper ~3312-3343) + calls in silent_retry/retryable_failure branches

  Why it fails at runtime: Terminal `REVIEWER_ADVANCE` line becomes non-deterministic for certain retryable classes, breaking the "deterministic advance" contract and making log-based stall-recovery diagnosis brittle.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
- File: .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml
  Line: reviewer_stall_recovery_next_action Python helper (~6873-6880) + summary construction (~7085-7099)
  Problem: The regex only captures `next_action=...` when the line also contains `reason=stall_guard`.
  Why it fails at runtime: Non-stall-guard advances (budget-skip, unmapped, terminal_failure, etc.) are silently dropped from the per-slot `stall_recovery_next_action` field.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
- File: README.md (multiple locations) + .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml

  Why it fails at runtime: Other phases (implement, validate, orchestrate_poll) now inherit the review default unintentionally, widening the stall-guard blast radius beyond the scoped intent of issue #3719.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 3
